0x14c57d02:
You can't have an amusement park without rides! All of the rides, concession stands and decorations are modules for your amusement park.

Click the Edit button.
0x14c57d03: Everything in your amusement park has to be plopped along the Amusement Park Path. You'll need to draw this path from the entrance to wherever you want your first ride.
0x14c57d04: Visitors to your amusement park will head to high excitement rides first, then will look for low excitement rides, so you'll want to provide a good mixture of rides to keep them happy.
0x14c57d05:
After visiting a couple rides, visitors will want to visit a concession stand. If they can't find one, they'll leave.

You profit directly from money spent on concessions, so make sure they can find one!
